style.toneOfVoice: This first Christmas bauble features a 3D layered woodland scene with cute illustrated characters huddled around a Christmas tree. The wooden tree is personalised with 4 text fields, with enough space to include the little one s first name, middle names or surname, birth date, and additional festive wording such as First Christmas. This may be split over two lines, depending on length. The design is printed onto the layers of wood and sits within a dusting of artificial snow inside the glass Christmas bauble. Baubles measure 10cm and are finished with velvet ribbon in your choice of colour. Dimensions(mm): Height: 110 Width: 110 Depth: 110.
